title: The 3 Best Milk Frothers Under $30
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for milk frothers under $30, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at milk frothers under $30 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Zulay Original Milk Frother
products.blurb: Key specs: Handheld battery-powered whisk, Under $15 typical price, Stainless steel whisk head.
strengths: Whisks foam in 15 to 20 seconds directly in the mug
Simple mechanically, with few parts that can fail
limitations: Doesn't heat milk, so it needs to be paired with a microwave or stovetop for hot drinks
Foam is coarser than an induction countertop machine's microfoam
Runs on AA batteries that need periodic replacement

products.name: PowerLix Handheld Milk Frother with Stand
strengths: Works with hot or cold drinks
limitations: Foam is less fine than a jug frother

products.name: Maestri House LunaFro 2.0 Rechargeable Milk Frother
strengths: Good for matcha and protein shakes
limitations: Less fine foam than a jug

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
